3D user experience is a complex and multifaceted phenomenon that is influenced by a variety of factors, including the quality of the 3D content itself, the quality of the display device, and the user's own personal preferences and expectations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel user experience model for 3D streaming in wireless networks.
the user experience is highly correlated with the resolution of the 3D video, the quantization level of the compressed video, the wireless channel capacity and the packet loss ratio.
the 3D video quality is a function of the spatial and temporal resolution, the quantized bit rate, the network parameters, the network layer, the data link layer and the physical layer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the user experience for 2D and 3D video is significantly different.
3D video quality is not simply a function of the spatial and temporal resolution of the 3D video content, the quantization parameter or the wireless network conditions.
3D video quality is not only determined by the spatial and temporal quality of the video, but also by the wireless network conditions.
